ui.boardIntro: What IT watches, at a glance. It shows the network as the failure simulator sees it right now.
ui.oncallIntro: How a typical morning alarm is handled, from page to post-incident note.
ui.warningsIntro: Problems that are not outages yet. Fixed in time, they never become one.
ui.releaseIntro: How a new version of the practice software or a clinic app reaches the clinics.
ui.checksTitle: What IT checks before a release reaches the clinics

alert.restarted: {count} virtual servers were restarted by HA.
alert.certSoon: The certificate of {service} expires in {days} days.

warn.ups: {device}: battery runtime {value} min, below the expected {limit} min. The battery is ageing.
warn.cert: {device}: certificate expires in {value} days (warning from {limit} days).
warn.firmware: {device}: firmware reaches end of support in {value} months.
warn.lte: {device}: {value} % of the monthly LTE data volume used.

alert.title: Alert
alert.text: Monitoring: Hamburg's primary line is down, the clinic runs on LTE. On-call is paged.

triage.title: Triage
triage.text: Payments and practice software work over LTE; X-ray uploads are slow. Priority high, not critical.

runbook.title: Runbook
runbook.text: Firewall dashboard: WAN1 has no sync. Provider status page shows nothing. Ticket opened with the provider.

communicate.title: Communication
communicate.text: Message to the clinic manager: you are on LTE, avoid large uploads, next update at 09:00.

resolve.title: Resolution
resolve.text: The provider repairs a damaged fibre in the street. WAN1 is back, the tunnel returns to it.

review.title: Post-incident note
review.text: Cause: construction work. Prevention: alert on LTE data use, provider escalation contacts in the runbook.

staging.title: Staging
staging.text: The new version runs in a test environment with copies of real configurations.

pilot.title: Pilot clinic
pilot.text: One clinic gets it first, with IT ready; the others stay on the old version.

all.title: All clinics
all.text: After a quiet pilot week it goes out clinic by clinic, outside opening hours.

rollback.title: Rollback plan
rollback.text: The previous version stays ready, so a clinic can go back within an hour (illustrative).

check.compat: It runs on the macOS and browser versions the MDM currently installs.
check.network: It needs no new firewall rules, or they are requested and tested in staging.
check.devices: Printers, card terminals and lab interfaces still work with it.
check.window: Release outside opening hours, never on a Monday morning.
check.comms: Clinic managers know what changes and whom to call.
